messages:
Samir R: Day 3 check-in — laptop and VPN ✅, joined #devex pairing yesterday, finished security training. Running into two blockers: 1) pulling private images fails with a 403/401 from our docker registry; 2) K8s cluster DNS is intermittently resolving service names to wrong IPs. Did: added SSH key, got kube context (samir-dev), wired up local env, attempted a small model run. Today: need registry creds fixed, help diagnosing kube DNS, and GPU quota bump for a short eval project. Also pinging for PR #42 review when someone has a moment.

Priya C: Thanks Samir! For the registry 401/403 — can you paste the exact error? Also I'll escalate the GPU quota. For the K8s DNS flakiness, try restarting coredns in kube-system: `kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deployment/coredns` and then `kubectl exec -it <pod> -- cat /etc/resolv.conf` to check DNS config.

IT Support: IT Support: Hey Samir — I provisioned read access to `docker-registry` for your username (samir@redwood.ai) and sent a token via DM. Try `docker logout` then `docker login registry.redwood.ai -u samir@redwood.ai -p <token>` and then `docker pull registry.redwood.ai/rwd-private/model:latest`. If you still see errors, paste the exact CLI output here and we'll look deeper.

Samir R: Logged in with the token but `docker pull registry.redwood.ai/rwd-private/model:latest` returns: `Error response from daemon: pull access denied for rwd-private/model, repository does not exist or may require 'docker login'` — I did `docker login` right before this. I also tried `curl -v -u samir@redwood.ai:<token> https://registry.redwood.ai/v2/` and got `401 Unauthorized`.

devex-bot: devex-bot: Reminder — onboarding checklist item "create model registry token" is still marked pending for Samir R. Checklist link: https://rwd.internal/onboarding/checklist

Alex M: Alex M: Thanks for the status. Priya — I'll help escalate the GPU quota; what's the project name? Samir — I'll take PR #42 this afternoon. Also if registry is still failing let's do a 30-min pairing at 15:00 PT today to walk through creds and traces.

Priya C: Priya C: GPU quota request submitted for project `samir-eval-1` (requested 1x T4 for 7 days), infra ETA ~1 business day. For the DNS issue — sometimes node-level dnsmasq caching causes stale replies; check `systemd-resolve --status` on the node if you can. Also confirm you don't have an override in `/etc/hosts` in the pod image.

Samir R: Samir R: Thanks all — pairing at 15:00 PT works for me. I'll attach the `curl -v` logs and `kubectl exec` output (resolv.conf) before then. Current blockers summary: registry 401/403, kube DNS flakiness, GPU quota pending. Today plan: finish PR #42 test fixes, gather traces for pairing, try the coredns restart suggestion. :thumbsup:
